summary: Index terminal ETA candidates and fold new terminal runs without rebuilding windows

replay.detail: Normal terminal transitions fold only the new run. Corrections and deletions refill through indexed newest-64 selection. Changed retained windows reactively invalidate published cards of other open runs sharing their definition hash and step path.

schema.detail: Add member-local terminal metadata and mission-change-cut projections, an ordered terminal candidate index, and a partial remaining-step index for shared-window consumers. A one-time version-4 sample migration backfills terminal metadata; a distinct run_eta_triggers_v4 revision upgrades older v3 trigger layouts once, preserving schema cookies on unchanged reopens.

rules.detail: Unusable terminal candidates still consume the 64-run bound. Existing selected-attempt durations, person-held exclusion, quartiles and true sample counts are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The integer Unix-ms ETA publication cut and public wire shape are unchanged.

downtime.detail: The additive local projection initializes during normal store opening.

recovery.detail: Rollback leaves the local projection unused; original claims and shared projections are unchanged.
